content.question: Side note: could humidity in the lab have affected the electrode assembly?
content.answer: Possibly. Humidity mainly affects electrode adhesion during assembly, but your assembly logs show the dry-room protocol was followed, so it is unlikely to change batch-level conclusions.

content.question: Unrelated: remind me how the VX-11 series was archived last year.
content.answer: The VX-11 series was archived by batch number with raw traces in the cold store and summaries in the shared drive, following the group's standard retention policy.

content.question: Correction from the re-run: the 2% peak was a measurement artifact from a miscalibrated probe. The corrected sweep shows the true peak at 4%. Update the working conclusion.
content.answer: Updated: conclusion v1 (2%) is retracted as a measurement artifact. Working conclusion v2: peak stability at 4% doping, from the recalibrated sweep.
